page.layout: One printed page, photographed rotated and strongly skewed, so the lines run diagonally. Left block: a column of short bibliographic title lines, reading from the top left down. Right block: a second column of title lines, partly hidden by streaks. Below the lower lines: the closing word "FINIS". A crest or device is printed in the lower left. No running head, page number or catchword is visible.

page.notes: The page is rotated and skewed; the text is read along the diagonal lines and many line ends are cut off or obscured by dark streaks, so most lines are only partly legible and are marked [illegible]. The right column is only partly visible at the edge of the scan. The grey background, wooden surface and Google watermark at the lower right are not part of the printed text and were left out. The crest in the lower left is a device, not text.
